experience.title: Experience
experience.intro: Internship experiences spanning software development, business analysis, database design, and enterprise IT workflows.

adm.description: Worked on business analysis, database design, web prototyping, and enterprise IT processes within the Digital Business Applications unit. Designed a PostgreSQL-based IT inventory and asset assignment system, built a React prototype for customer request management, and gained hands-on exposure to enterprise workflows involving SAP, Jira, Solution Manager, Qlik, SCADA, and OSOS.

inventory.title: IT Inventory, Stock and Asset Assignment System

crm.title: Customer Request Management CRM

enterprise.title: Enterprise IT and SAP Processes

massguard.title: MASSGuard AI / Watt If? Ideathon
massguard.desc: Concept proposal analyzing MASS smart meter time-series data to produce risk scores and field inspection priorities for electricity theft and bypass anomalies, unregistered solar generation, and unusual consumption patterns. Designed as a decision-support concept, not an autonomous decision system.
